summary: Iter 21 (fetch_english_image robustness) VERIFIED. Backend: 22/22 tests pass. NEW iter21_image_reliability suite: 5/5 sequential /api/scan-card calls with Pikachu Base 58 image ALL returned image_url != null, name=Pikachu, number=058/102, and price=$7.35 (JustTCG). Latencies: 5.4s, 5.5s, 5.8s, 8.0s, 14.7s. Non-card 1x1 png still returns identified=false gracefully. Full regression 20/20 green across health, root, scan-pikachu strict, scan-non-card, scan-blurry, history, transcribe, voice-chat x2, collection CRUD x5, graded-prices x2, grade-estimate x2, iter16 non-strict x2. Code review of fetch_english_image at server.py:403-447 confirms all 4 robustness features are implemented correctly: (a) queries list built in priority order — name+number, then name+zero-padded-3-digit, then name-only [lines 408-414]; (b) pageSize=5 with orderBy=-set.releaseDate [line 422]; (c) 5xx retry-once via `if r.status_code >= 500: continue` inside a 2-iter attempt loop [line 424-425]; (d) prefer-number-match filter iterates data and picks card whose _num_key(c.number) == n [lines 430-437] before falling back to data[0]. Vision model still claude-sonnet-4-5 (VISION_MODEL at server.py:157-158, reused for grade-estimate at line 902). No frontend testing (per request).
